ev.q: In 2021, 71.6% of adults aged 50–75 years reported they received the recommended colorectal cancer screening
Overall, 72.6% of women and 70.6% of men received the recommended screening
71.6% of adults aged 50–75 years reported they received the recommended colorectal cancer screening
with the percentage increasing with income from 56.7% for those with family incomes <100% of FPL to 63.0%
the percentage was higher among women than men with family incomes 100% to <200% of FPL (68.1% versus 57.2%)
Age-adjusted percentages are based on the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau standard population using age groups 50–64 and 65–75 years
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: Age-adjusted percentages are based on the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau standard population using age groups 50–64 and 65–75 years
